name: [Section] — [Focused Eval Name]
source: Production Evals methodology + operator review + relevant user stories + prior evidence
outcome: What will be proven when this sprint is complete.
acceptanceCriteria: PE-SECTION-01.AC1: Section / page function map exists in interface terms.
PE-SECTION-01.AC2: Use case inventory includes happy path, negative path, and edge cases.
PE-SECTION-01.AC3: Acceptance matrix defines expected outcomes, evidence required, and data-truth checks.
PE-SECTION-01.AC4: Every executed flow has evidence and commentary.
PE-SECTION-01.AC5: Bugs found are logged with severity, type, false-pass class, and status.
PE-SECTION-01.AC6: Remediation retests are completed or explicitly deferred.
PE-SECTION-01.AC7: Post-sprint review includes confidence assessment and next recommendation.
entryGates: A1: Relevant governance and product sources read (production-evals pack, CLAUDE.md, sprints.json, feature map, user stories).
A2: Scope limited to one section or subsection.
A3: User story gate satisfied — expected behavior defined in interface terms.
A4: Pre-execution report exists with objective, section map, use cases, acceptance matrix, evidence plan, action-boundary review.
A5: Irreversible actions approved or explicitly excluded.
A7: Watchdog scan run — violations acknowledged or zero.
A8: Sprint registered in sprints.json with status committed.
A9: Ghost Entry Gate — ENTRY GATE: APPROVED in pre-execution-report.md.
exitGates: B1: All planned flows have execution reports with evidence and commentary.
B2: Data-accuracy checks documented for all metric/data-heavy flows.
B3: False-pass detection performed with classes documented.
B4: Bug log updated with status for every issue found.
B5: Remediation retests completed or explicitly deferred.
B6: Post-sprint review written with confidence and recommendation.
B7: Enforcer-checklist.txt exists with RESULT: APPROVED.
B8: Cross-sign.md exists with verdict: approved and different reviewing role.
B9: If code changed, relevant tests rerun and recorded.
B10: Ghost Exit Gate — EXIT GATE: CLEARED in post-sprint-report.md.
wholeProductFit: Why this section matters to production readiness.

executionSteps.action: Sprint registration + pre-execution package + Ghost Entry Gate
Section function map + use case inventory + acceptance matrix
Bug triage and remediation loop if authorized
Post-sprint report + enforcer checklist + cross-sign + Ghost Exit Gate
